author: Arnav
problem: Read an H by W grid of integers A. Print Yes if, for every choice of rows i1 < i2 and columns j1 < j2, A[i1][j1] + A[i2][j2] <= A[i2][j1] + A[i1][j2]; otherwise print No.
bug_description: Uses < instead of >, so it rejects grids where the main-diagonal corners sum to less than the anti-diagonal ones (the allowed case) and accepts the ones it should reject.

comments.accurate: Checks every pair of rows and columns: the main-diagonal corners must never sum to more than the anti-diagonal corners
comments.wrong_behavior: Checks every pair of rows and columns: the main-diagonal corners must never sum to less than the anti-diagonal corners
comments.wrong_location: Corner comparison verified; check the inner loops start one past the outer row and column

source.buggy_line: if A[h][w] + A[i][j] < A[i][w] + A[h][j] : flag = False
source.fixed_line: if A[h][w] + A[i][j] > A[i][w] + A[h][j] : flag = False
